svg.title: White Curve V, 1973 — interpretive SVG study
svg.desc: White and black are painted areas within a rectangular canvas; neither is a transparent cutout. Curved division approximated from an installation photograph, with orientation cross-checked against the museum warning about the inverted historic cover. Palette refinement (2026-11-09): source review remains unresolved for black, white; prior provisional screen colors retained, not calibrated to original paint.
svg.metadata: Primary record: https://art.seattleartmuseum.org/objects/20691/white-curve-v; visual reference: https://scaruffi.com/museums/sam/index.html; reviewed 2026-10-27; hand-authored interpretive study, not a facsimile; approximate geometry and interpretive screen colours.
